esp32.detail: 10 pins wired; VNH2SP30 Monster Moto dual motor shield needs at least 4.5 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.INA2 → D25 (GPIO25). U2.PWM1 → D26 (GPIO26). U2.PWM2 → D27 (GPIO27). U2.INA1 → D13 (GPIO13). U2.INB1 → D23 (GPIO23). U2.INB2 → D19 (GPIO19). Added a separate 12 V supply for VIN (it needs 5.5–16 V and up to 20 A, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the vnh2sp30.py driver written from the datasheet.
Motor 1 runs clockwise, then brakes to GND: passes
